# managementserver

```go
import "banyan/management-server"
```

Package managementserver provides an HTTP management API server for Banyan nodes. It exposes REST endpoints for node management, peer connections, service discovery, proxying, tunneling, and real\-time event streaming via WebSockets.

The server is started using StartManagementServer which returns a ManagementServer instance and the server URL. All endpoints support CORS for cross\-origin requests from web\-based management interfaces.
